# Rule 2 — No hate speech, harassment, or slurs
Do not use hate speech, discriminatory language, or slurs. This includes targeted attacks against protected or marginalized groups.
Do not use jokes, memes, character roleplay, or in-character speech as an excuse for hateful or discriminatory behavior.
Harassment, stalking, dogpiling, repeated unwanted contact, or targeted hostility toward a player or staff member is not allowed.
This applies to usernames, character names, descriptions, in-game speech, adminhelps, Discord, and any other official Project Verdant space.
